messages.subject: Calibration
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I made a manual calibration of some parameters.  Because of that, I want to maintain the calibrated values of these parameters and use the R-SWAT to calibrate other parameters. How could I do that?

Best regards,
Dário.

messages.subject: Error while conducting calibration for monthly data
messages.subject_clean: Error while conducting calibration for monthly data
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tam

Congratulation on developing R-SWAT.

I have worked with your example data, and it seems to run
without problem However, I have problem while trying to calibrate my monthly
river flow time series. For this purpose, I applied your UserReadSwatOutput
file and changed it for my data. Based on my File.cio, my model has 36 years of
simulated data beginning from 1979. I want to apply the data from 1981 (as
there is two year of warm-up period) to 1990 for calibration at first. To make
the problem simple, I only used one gaging station out of 128 subbasins and
changed the date between 1981-1-1 to 1990-12-31 both in UserReadSwatOutput and
model (select date range). Every time I run the model it executes 36 years of
simulation (e.g. dose not care about my requested date range) and finally gives
the following error:

Warning: Error in data.frame: arguments imply differing
number of rows: 3652, 438

Your help is greatly appreciated.

Best
